intelligence.enrichment: Roots take up water along with minerals from the soil, and xylem transports them to leaves and other parts of the plant. Root uptake of water and minerals -> upward transport through xylem -> arrival at leaves, stems, and flowers. The learner correctly applies this rule: Roots take up water along with minerals from the soil, and xylem transports them to leaves and other parts of the plant. Water spreads through any visible part of a plant, so named tubes and upward direction do not matter.
